jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections,  where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

We are looking for a highly motivated R&D Scientist to drive research in the field of neurodegenerative diseases. In this role, you will focus on analyzing the aggregation properties of proteins, specifically regarding Parkinson's and Alzheimer's disease, and will implement methods like the Seed Amplification Assays (SAA).Your responsibilities will encompass the planning, execution, and documentation of research on these assays and experimental methods to support a global project.

This position involves working primarily in the laboratory, where you will also take on routine organizational and coordinative tasks to keep operations running smoothly.

Your Key Responsibilities/Position:
* Plan and manage sub-projects while coordinating task execution largely independently.
* Conduct laboratory experiments in coordination with project teams and other lab infrastructure users.
* Analyze, interpret, and document R&D results independently, align with project teams and, where necessary, further subject matter experts, present your findings to relevant committees in both German and English.
* Act as the responsible equipment manager, maintaining measuring instruments independently.
* Ensure that all quality standards, safety guidelines, and environmental protection regulations are strictly met in the laboratory.
* Collaborate actively across subchapters or chapters, and occasionally represent the team leader in project teams when instructed.
* Track new developments in the field and evaluate their potential application in diagnostics.

Who you are:
* You have successfully completed a Master's degree in Neuroscience, Biology, or a comparable discipline.
* You bring at least 3 years of professional experience in neurosciences within national and international (especially US-American) environments.
* You possess profound, proven specialist knowledge of neurodegenerative diseases, with a specific focus on Parkinson's disease and Alzheimer's dementia.
* You have several years of practical laboratory experience, whereby at least 1 year of hands-on experience with Seed Amplification Assays (SAA) is strictly required for this role.
* You have solid theoretical knowledge and practical experience with additional laboratory methods, particularly ELISA, flow cytometry, qPCR, and microscopy.
* You have a background in industrial diagnostics research, backed by strong problem-solving skills and a collaborative mindset.
* Your scientific profile is complemented by practical experience in data analysis and statistics.
* You possess excellent advanced English and German skills (min. B2 level) and are proficient in standard IT tools like Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and comparable Google software.

jobs.description:
Siemens Digital Industries Software - Transform the everyday.
Let's make the difference together!
Siemens EDA is a global technology leader in Electronic
Design Automation software. Our software tools enable companies around the
world to develop highly innovative electronic products faster and more
cost-effectively. Our customers use our tools to push the boundaries of
technology and physics to deliver better products in the increasingly complex
world of chip, board, and system design.
Position Overview
Join our elite R&D team as a EDA Product Validation Engineer (m/f/d),
where you will play a key role in driving the automation and continuous
improvement of our software testing processes for advanced integrated circuit
testing solutions. We are seeking an experienced quality engineering expert who
can design, implement, and optimize robust test automation frameworks while
applying strong knowledge in physical implementation, static timing analysis, and timing constraints.
Job responsibilities:

- Creating
test-plans for comprehensive features/enhancements for one of the
developed tools
- Manual
verification of the newly implemented code, using proven 3rd party tools
where needed
- Reporting
defects, ability localizing the issue, providing necessary input
to reproduce it, including scripts, layouts, etc.
- Working
closely with Application Engineers on analyzing issues
on customers side
- Implementing
regression tests for covering the introduced code
- Daily
and on demand runs of tests, reporting the results to counterparts
- Providing
weekly reports with brief description of the work done and the plan for
the next week
- Participating QA
and cross-functional team meetings

Required Qualifications:

- BS/MS
in an EDA or Computer science related area – Cybernetics, Computer
science, Microelectronics, Applied Math, etc.
- Knowledge
of full RTL to GDS|| flow
- Strong
knowledge of static timing analysis
- Strong
knowledge of timing constraining and their impact on ASIC flow
- Knowledge
of SystemVerilog Assertions is preferable
- Knowledge
of different DFT methodologies is preferable
- experience
in automated software testing preferably in EDA area
- Scripting/Programming
skills, knowledge of basic algorithms, ability of estimating the
complexity of algorithms, creating and implementing ones
- Basic
knowledge of Boolean algebra and logical circuits
- Basic
knowledge about EDA flow and manufacturing process
- Fluent
verbal and written English, ability to work in an international team,
having regular international team meetings
- Good
planning skills, basic knowledge of one of planning tools –
JIRA, MS Project, etc.
- Experience
of working with a source control and an issue tracking tool
- Readiness
to support team members in force major situations
